lines.zh: 我的身体滑过泥地，草都不动。
lines.en: My body slides over mud; not a blade stirs.

lines.zh: 我走的是水路，你看不见波纹。
lines.en: I travel by water; you see no ripples.
My scales rasp the roots, hush-hush.
In a day I move only a short stretch.

lines.zh: 绿鳞在雾里，和水草一个颜色。
lines.en: Green scales in mist, the color of waterweed.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，能感觉到脚步。
lines.en: Belly to the ground, I feel every footstep.
The yellow one is my cousin.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴还在后头，慢慢跟上来。
lines.en: My tail follows behind, slowly catching up.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥是软的，正合我意。
lines.en: Swamp mud is soft, just right for me.

lines.zh: 别踩我的背，我会整个缠上来。
lines.en: Do not step on my back; I coil entirely.

lines.zh: 我穿过芦苇，一根都没折断。
lines.en: I pass through reeds without breaking one.
I go slow so I make no sound.
Slithering, hiss嘶嘶声
Moving, seeking prey

lines.zh: 扭动身体，发出轻微响声
lines.en: Body writhing, soft sounds
Moving slowly in mud
I glide along the bottom, mouth ajar.
Large eyes, searching for prey
Sliding in water, leaving tail mark
Body writhing, preparing to attack
Swallowing prey, making noise

lines.zh: 在草丛中移动，隐匿身形
lines.en: Moving in grass, hiding

lines.zh: 它把水推出身侧，缓缓滑过。
lines.en: It pushes the water aside and slides past.
It shoulders a path through the mud.

lines.zh: 我盘在树根上，一动不动。
lines.en: I coil on the roots, utterly still.
My tongue flickers out and tastes the wind.

lines.zh: 消化一顿饭，要躺上好几天。
lines.en: Digesting a meal takes several days of lying still.
My skin is starting to fade.

lines.zh: 吃饱以后，鳞片失去光泽。
lines.en: After a full meal, my scales lose their shine.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，把下巴松开一格。
lines.en: I open my mouth and unhinge my jaw a notch.
The swamp bubbles; I listen.

lines.zh: 这片水洼，谁也不敢下来。
lines.en: No one dares enter this pool.

lines.zh: 我把自己打了个结，又解开。
lines.en: I tie myself in a knot, then undo it.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我在想下一顿。
lines.en: In the quiet, I think of the next meal.
I'm coiled in the swamp water.

lines.zh: 我盘在倒木上，鳞片发暖。
lines.en: I coil on a fallen log and let my scales warm.
Resting by water, observing
Enjoying sun, relaxing
Closing eyes, waiting
Basking on shore, relaxing
Lying quietly on grass

lines.zh: 在阴影中休息，恢复体力
lines.en: Resting in shade, regaining
Enjoying calm, waiting for prey

lines.zh: 静静地等待下一个猎物
lines.en: Waiting for next prey

lines.zh: 它盘在树根上，只动信子。
lines.en: Coiled on a root, it moves only its tongue.

lines.zh: 它的鳞片在沼泽里泛着油光。
lines.en: Its scales shine oily in the swamp light.

lines.zh: 它把身子埋进淤泥里降温。
lines.en: It sinks into the silt to cool down.

lines.zh: 它一节一节地收紧自己的身体。
lines.en: It tightens its coils one section at a time.

lines.zh: 它盯着水面的落叶看了很久。
lines.en: It stares a long while at a leaf on the water.

lines.zh: 它抬头换了口气，又沉下去。
lines.en: It lifts its head for air, then sinks again.
It lies still among the mangrove roots.

lines.zh: 它的尾巴缠着一根倒木。
lines.en: Its tail is wrapped around a fallen log.

lines.zh: 你站住别动，我在量你的宽度。
lines.en: Stand still; I am measuring your width.
You are thinner than my own body.
I have coiled things bigger than you.

lines.zh: 你的喉咙动了一下，我看见了。
lines.en: Your throat moved; I saw it.

lines.zh: 别看我眼睛，看久了会僵。
lines.en: Do not meet my eyes too long; you will freeze.
You smell of sweat, very fresh.
I am in no hurry. I never am.

lines.zh: 抬起头来，让我看看你的下巴。
lines.en: Lift your head; let me see your jaw.
You are holding that blade wrong.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边待了有一会儿了。
lines.en: I have been at your feet for a while.
Sharp gaze on player

lines.zh: 我在水草后面，量你的腿。
lines.en: Behind the weeds, I measure your legs.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水纹动了一下，我盘紧了
lines.en: A ripple in the swamp, and I coil tighter
Opening mouth, threatening

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面，被我盘成一圈。
lines.en: I have coiled the swamp's surface into a ring.
Watching player in darkness
Noticing player, ready to strike
Staring, ready to swallow
Locking on player, waiting
Opening mouth, making threat

lines.zh: 它从泥里抬起头，正对上你的眼。
lines.en: It lifts its head from the mud, meeting your eyes.

lines.zh: 它顺着你踩倒的草看过来。
lines.en: It follows the grass you trampled and looks at you.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的鳞上，滑开了。
lines.en: Your blade slid off my scales.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来了，你也该退了。
lines.en: I coil up; you should back away.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的气味。
lines.en: That blow, I remember your scent.
A shallow cut through the flesh.
Snakes do not cry out, but we lunge.

lines.zh: 别以为打一下我就跑了。
lines.en: Do not think one hit will drive me off.
My tail whips around; duck.
It hurts, but I do not let go.

lines.zh: 你把我的鳞打掉了几片。
lines.en: You knocked off a few of my scales.

lines.zh: 我往后退，是为了再扑一次。
lines.en: I retreat only to strike again.
It hurts where you're holding me.
My wound hurts so much, save me.
Can't you see I'm hurt?
Help me, I'm dying.
Please don't eat me.
Save me, I'm nearly dead.
Stop touching me, it hurts.
Please don't hurt me anymore.
Blood seeps under my scales; I shrink into the mud.
Release me, save me!

lines.zh: 有东西在跳，心跳的动静。
lines.en: Something is pulsing; a heartbeat's stir.
Alive, warm, and moving.

lines.zh: 那点动静，勾得我舌头发痒。
lines.en: That small stir makes my tongue itch.
The more it struggles, the more I want it.

lines.zh: 我不吃死的，死的没意思。
lines.en: I do not eat the dead; they are dull.
Hold that one in your arms tightly.

lines.zh: 热气的方向，我闻得清清楚楚。
lines.en: I smell exactly where that warmth comes from.

lines.zh: 这么大的猎物，够我躺半个月。
lines.en: Prey that size would last me half a month.
My jaw is already unhinged.
Do not lift it high; I cannot reach.

lines.zh: 你会被我庞大的身躯吞噬！
lines.en: I'll devour you with my massive body!
One step closer and the mud reaches your waist.
My scales rake across your hand.

lines.zh: 你晃的那只鸡，味道很大。
lines.en: That chicken you dangle smells strong.

lines.zh: 你手里的肉，比鱼腥更重。
lines.en: The meat in your hand smells stronger than fish.

lines.zh: 我的绿色是自然的警告！
lines.en: My green warns of nature!

lines.zh: 不要招惹我，你会后悔的！
lines.en: Don't provoke me, you'll regret it!
My size can engulf you!

lines.zh: 沼泽里，我的身子上沾着泥。
lines.en: In the swamp, mud clings to my body.
I'm the queen here!

lines.zh: 你碰到我的身子了，凉的。
lines.en: You touched my body; it is cold.
Do not step there; that is my middle.
I went around you; it took effort.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我闻到了害怕。
lines.en: As you backed off, I smelled fear.

lines.zh: 这条道太窄，我们挤不过去。
lines.en: The path is narrow; we cannot both pass.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片刮到你的靴子了。
lines.en: My scales scraped your boot.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我当你是在招呼我。
lines.en: A bump, and I take it as an invitation.
Do not push with your hands; snakes hold grudges.

lines.zh: 我身体长，你从哪边都躲不开。
lines.en: I am long; you cannot dodge either end.

lines.zh: 让开吧，我不想现在就用劲。
lines.en: Move aside; I would rather not exert myself now.
In the swamp mud, you're in my way.
Your bones are pressing my scales.
Don't collide with me!
Be careful, I won't be merciful!
One dash in the water and I am gone.

lines.zh: 你太轻巧了，无法伤害我！
lines.en: You're too light to harm me!

lines.zh: 你的碰撞对我来说微不足道！
lines.en: Your collision means nothing to me!
You're blocking my prey!
My scales can block you!
You can't stop me!

lines.zh: 母蛇比我更长，我得仰头看。
lines.en: The female is longer; I must look up.

lines.zh: 我用下巴蹭她的背，慢慢来。
lines.en: I rub her back with my chin, slowly.
Coiled together, we are not fighting.

lines.zh: 沼泽的雨季，才轮到这件事。
lines.en: Only in the swamp's rainy season does this come.
Neither of us makes a sound.
When it is done, we part ways.
Her scales shine a little brighter.

lines.zh: 别过来看，这不是给你瞧的。
lines.en: Do not come watch; this is not for you.
Snakes have no wedding, only tangling.
This old skin of mine is due for a change.

lines.zh: 找个伴儿吧，我需要繁殖！
lines.en: Find a mate, I need to breed!
Let's procreate together!
Find a mate, my need!
Under the mangrove roots, I left my scent.
Use my power to breed!
Let's establish a family together!
That green shape in the swamp is me.

lines.zh: 沼泽里还有谁比我更长？
lines.en: Who in this swamp is longer than me?

lines.zh: 我的繁殖需求无法忽视！
lines.en: My breeding needs can't be ignored!

lines.zh: 我的繁殖欲望无法抑制！
lines.en: My breeding desire can't be suppressed!
I take it in my mouth and swallow slowly.

lines.zh: 这东西太小，塞不满我的嘴。
lines.en: Too small to fill my mouth.
I have no hands to pick it up.
Down it goes, bones and all.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，多半是死的。
lines.en: What lies on the ground is usually dead.

lines.zh: 我试着卷起来，它滑掉了。
lines.en: I try to coil around it; it slips away.

lines.zh: 这块肉凉了，我勉强收下。
lines.en: The meat is cold; I accept it grudgingly.

lines.zh: 我咽得太慢，喉咙会鼓起来。
lines.en: I swallow slowly; my throat bulges.
Do not pull it from beneath; I bite.
After this, I must lie still three days.
Long body coils around you.
Within reach, delicious.
Green anaconda appears.
Swims in water, surfaces on land.
Prey in my grasp.
Green scales shimmer.
Yellow-green scales.
Strong, powerful bite.
Hunter from the swamp.
Hungering anaconda.

lines.zh: 它在水边低头，这就是机会。
lines.en: It lowers its head at the water; that is my chance.

lines.zh: 我早就在这棵树后等着了。
lines.en: I have waited behind this tree all along.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，我的颜色帮了忙。
lines.en: It does not see me; my color helps.
This strike must take the neck.
Alive, breathing; that one.
It walked too close to the water.

lines.zh: 我的身体已经在它脚边盘好了。
lines.en: My body is already coiled at its feet.

lines.zh: 不要急，等它再往前一步。
lines.en: Patience; wait for one more step.

lines.zh: 它心跳的声音，盖过了水声。
lines.en: Its heartbeat drowns out the water.
The small one has the tenderest meat.

lines.zh: 它把背对着我，真是失礼。
lines.en: It turns its back to me. How careless.

lines.zh: 沼泽会替我把它留下的。
lines.en: The swamp will help me keep it.
This meal will last me half a season.

lines.zh: 别动，我缠上来就不会松。
lines.en: Do not move; once I coil, I do not let go.

lines.zh: 芦苇那头有个影子在晃。
lines.en: A shadow sways at the far end of the reeds.
That body is small enough to swallow.
Target sighted.
Your footprints in the mud, one deep, one shallow.
Breathing you in.
Tracking movement.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水告诉我，你在哪。
lines.en: The swamp water tells me where you are.
Smelling you out.

lines.zh: 我在沼泽里盘好了，等你走近。
lines.en: Coiled in the swamp, I wait for you to come close.
Tracking your trail.
Scenting you.
Target moving.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面过去，一点声音都没有。
lines.en: I cross the ground without a sound.

lines.zh: 它回头看了一次，没看见。
lines.en: It glanced back once and saw nothing.

lines.zh: 我绕到它下游，水会带走气味。
lines.en: I circle downstream; water carries my scent away.

lines.zh: 它数着自己的脚步，我数着它的。
lines.en: It counts its steps; I count them too.

lines.zh: 再吵一点，我就能确定位置。
lines.en: A little more noise, and I will know exactly.
I wait for it to set the weapon down.

lines.zh: 它的影子落在水里，从我身上划过。
lines.en: Its shadow crosses the water and over me.

lines.zh: 泥太软，我压出了浅浅的痕。
lines.en: The mud is soft; I leave a faint groove.

lines.zh: 我停下来，让它以为自己安全。
lines.en: I stop, letting it think it is safe.
It is starting to breathe heavily.

lines.zh: 我离它的脚踝只有一臂。
lines.en: I am one arm's length from its ankle.

lines.zh: 它靠着树，那棵树是我的。
lines.en: It leans on the tree; that tree is mine.

lines.zh: 我的舌头记住了它的气味。
lines.en: My tongue has memorized its scent.

lines.zh: 等它坐下，一切都容易了。
lines.en: Once it sits, everything becomes easy.

lines.zh: 我把头压得很低，快到泥面。
lines.en: I press my head low, almost to the mud.

lines.zh: 你在浅水里，脚步声很响。
lines.en: You're in the shallows, and your steps are loud.
I'm counting how many breaths you have left.

lines.zh: 你往左，我的尾巴早等在下游。
lines.en: Go left — my tail is already waiting downstream.

lines.zh: 别回头看，我就在那后面。
lines.en: Don't look back. I'm right behind there.

lines.zh: 这条水沟，只留一个出口。
lines.en: This ditch has only one way out.
I lift my forebody out of the water.
Targeting weak point.
Homing in on vital point.
Targeting hit point.
Homing in on heart.
Targeting critical point.

lines.zh: 我顺着你踩断的草看过去。
lines.en: I follow the grass you snapped.
Targeting lethal strike.

lines.zh: 它把你量了量，够它吃一顿。
lines.en: It measures you: enough for one meal.
It circles around to downwind of you.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的腿，然后缠上去。
lines.en: I bite its leg, then coil around it.
One loop, two loops; I keep count.
Its bones creak beneath my coils.

lines.zh: 别吸气，你越吸气我缠得越紧。
lines.en: Do not breathe in; each breath tightens me.

lines.zh: 它捶我的背，跟捶泥一样。
lines.en: It pounds my back as if pounding mud.
My muscles tighten, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 它挣得越凶，力气掉得越快。
lines.en: The harder it struggles, the faster it weakens.

lines.zh: 我把头抬起来，看着它的眼睛。
lines.en: I raise my head and look into its eyes.
This bite lands on its shoulder.

lines.zh: 它的手抓着我的鳞，没用。
lines.en: Its hands clutch my scales; useless.

lines.zh: 我把身子铺开，压住它的腿。
lines.en: I spread my length and pin its legs.
It has gone quiet; I keep tightening.
I swallow it whole, leaving nothing.

lines.zh: 吃饱了，我得找个地方躺着。
lines.en: Full now; I need somewhere to lie.

lines.zh: 我先把尾巴绕上你的脚。
lines.en: I loop my tail around your feet first.

lines.zh: 你张嘴喊，正好让我咬住。
lines.en: You open your mouth to shout, and I bite.

lines.zh: 我收紧的时候，你听见骨头响。
lines.en: When I tighten, you hear your bones creak.

lines.zh: 我换个角度，又缠上一层。
lines.en: I shift my angle and coil one more layer.
Your hands claw at nothing on my back.

lines.zh: 这一吞，连你的武器一起。
lines.en: This gulp takes your weapon along with you.

lines.zh: 沼泽的浑水一鼓，就是我要咬下去。
lines.en: When the swamp water bulges, that's my bite coming.
My coils tighten ring by ring.

lines.zh: 你的肉将填饱我的肚子！
lines.en: Your flesh will fill my belly.
Hold on tight, you won't last long.
Enjoy your final struggle!

lines.zh: 我一圈圈收，泥都挤出来。
lines.en: I coil tighter, squeezing the mud out.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥裹着你，动不了。
lines.en: The swamp mud holds you fast.

lines.zh: 牙先挂住，身子再绕上来。
lines.en: My teeth hook first, then my body follows.

lines.zh: 你每挣一下，我就紧一分。
lines.en: Every struggle tightens me by a notch.
Enjoy my无情的拥抱!

lines.zh: 我从沼泽底下的泥里游上来。
lines.en: I swim up from the mud beneath the swamp.

lines.zh: 水面的雾，是我呼出来的。
lines.en: The mist on the water is my breath.

lines.zh: 第一件事，是找棵树靠着。
lines.en: First thing: find a tree to lean on.

lines.zh: 这身绿皮，够我藏一整年。
lines.en: This green hide will hide me all year.

lines.zh: 水里已经有我的味道了。
lines.en: The water already carries my scent.
I am longer than this pool.

lines.zh: 沼泽里多了条影子，就是我。
lines.en: A new shadow in the swamp; that is me.

lines.zh: 我盘起来，像一堆旧绳子。
lines.en: I coil up like a heap of old rope.
The reeds sway; I did not touch them.
Hunger rises from my belly.
I flick my tongue and learn the paths.

lines.zh: 这地方安静，正适合伏着。
lines.en: Quiet here; good for lying in wait.
Muddy water over my back — perfect.
I'll wait here for prey.
I sink into the murk with only my tail tip out.
Green and red trees, my domain!
I'm the king here!
Enjoy nature's embrace!

lines.zh: 沼泽深处，才有我的踪迹！
lines.en: Only in the depths of the swamp do I roam!
This land will nourish me!
Redwood swamp, my domain!

lines.zh: 红树根缝里，我探出鼻尖。
lines.en: I poke my snout from a mangrove root gap.

lines.zh: 沼泽冒了个泡，水面浮起一段绿。
lines.en: A bubble pops and a green length surfaces.

lines.zh: 红树根后，多了一截湿滑的背。
lines.en: Behind the mangrove roots, a wet back appears.

lines.zh: 火烫着我的鳞，我往水里滑。
lines.en: Fire burns my scales; I slide into water.
The fire burns my skin.

lines.zh: 我从树上掉下来，摔得不轻。
lines.en: I fell from the tree, and it hurt.

lines.zh: 从树上掉下来，肋骨发闷。
lines.en: Falling from the tree, my ribs ache dully.
I can coil underwater for a whole day.
Swamp water got into my mouth.

lines.zh: 炸得我身子散开，又缠回来。
lines.en: The blast scatters my coils; they gather again.
The explosion injured me.

lines.zh: 箭插在我身上，我照样往前。
lines.en: An arrow in me; I keep coming.
An arrow hurt me.

lines.zh: 魔法从我鳞缝里钻进来。
lines.en: Magic seeps between my scales.

lines.zh: 沼泽的泥裹不住我的鳞。
lines.en: Swamp mud won't stick to my scales.

lines.zh: 很久没吃了，我的皮都松了。
lines.en: Long without food; my skin hangs loose.
I'm starving, feed me.

lines.zh: 雷打在沼泽上，我的鳞发麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the swamp; my scales tingle.

lines.zh: 雷打在鳞上，我整条一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hits my scales and my whole length jerks.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥，也没有猎物。
lines.en: No mud in the void, and no prey.
Void hurt me.
